name: Polar Bear
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 15. Languages none.
appearance: A large bear with dense ivory fur, broad paws, black nose and a long, low profile.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 367, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195167-polar-bear
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Rend attacks.
Rend. Make a +7 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage.

name: Pony
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A small sturdy chestnut horse with a flaxen mane and tail, white blaze and pale lower legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 367, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775833-pony

name: Pteranodon
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A slender flying reptile with stretched leathery wings, a long pointed beak and a swept-back reddish crest.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 367, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195173-pteranodon
sections.Traits: Flyby. The pteranodon can fly out of an enemy’s reach without provoking an Opportunity Attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a +4 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Rat
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A brown rat with rounded ears, a pointed whiskered nose and a long bare tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 367, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775836-rat
sections.Traits: Agile. The rat can move out of an enemy’s reach without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a +2 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.

name: Raven
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A black raven with layered blue-black feathers, a heavy curved bill and a shaggy throat.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast’s 2024-rules Monster Manual, p. 368, as published on D&D Beyond. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775837-raven
sections.Traits: Mimicry. The raven can copy simple sounds it has heard. A listener who succeeds on a DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check recognizes the imitation.
sections.Actions: Beak. Make a +4 melee attack within 5 ft. A hit deals 1 piercing damage.
